recentItems.title: The catastrophic air pressure at 16,000ft in the sky | 60 Minutes Australia
recentItems.description:
Most passengers experience the air pressure mid-flight at a minimal level because modern aircrafts regulate it for human comfort. It’s then difficult to imagine the physical toll a human body experiences when exposed to the raw pressure 16,000ft up in the sky, as Ryanair passenger Ljubisa Karović did.

Full story on the 60 Minutes Australia YouTube channel: https://youtu.be/bL7SRL-O0nE
